snippet.title: Safari-TV - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Run wild expeditions with friends in Safari-TV, a co-op safari simulator where you drive tourists through an open world and turn every trip into content. Build and customize your physics-driven safari truck, film wildlife and chaos, grow your audience, and take on dangerous routes for bigger rewards.

👉 add it to your wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5118500/SafariTV/

🎮 main channel: https://www.youtube.com/@explorerdotgames

🌐 other platforms: https://beacons.ai/explorer.games

#SafariTV #SimulationGame #CoopGame
